# Capture checklist: Scenic rides

<!-- Generated by `node core/bin/capture.ts build` from data/vocab/types.json and core/src/schema/capture/properties.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

R is required for Usable, R? is required when its condition holds, A is applicable (counts for Complete). Properties not listed are never asked. Suitability paths are listed under their profile; the full list for a type is `node core/bin/capture.ts fields --type <id>`.

## Lifts and cable cars (`ride.lift`)

Records: route, offer. Suitability profile `lift` (always, extension lift). Effort: none, time is shown. Sources, in order: O T.

**route**: R name, type, point, area_id, summary, access_points, access_cost, class_key, draw, standing, distinction, easy_payoff, weather, why, signals, links, reaches, geometry, starts_at; R? closures (status_page), part_of (part_of_something); A names, wikidata, osm_ref, best_window, best_time, transit, pairs_with, photos, passes, high_point_m, turnaround_points, gpx_licence, snow_free_window.

**offer (ticket)**: R name, type, summary, season, hours, access_cost, price, links, on; R? window (bookable), closures (status_page), part_of (part_of_something); A names, best_window, best_time, transit, pairs_with, photos, at, run_by, variants, included.

Suitability: R stroller_on_board, wheelchair, on_site_min, access_season, participation.weather_cancel, ext.lift.cabin, ext.lift.last_up, ext.lift.last_down; R when operated none; A min_age, min_height_cm, max_height_cm, limit_reason, adult_required, solo, age_band, kid_note, carrier_ok, access_detail, accessible_toilet, accessible_parking, limited_capacity_note, toilets, food, altitude_m, ext.lift.ride_min.

Links: official; R? none; A hours_rates, booking, status, timetable, webcam.
